integrity: Exact conditional geometric sums and a stationary generating-function identity support the formulas. Independent validation and historical-priority determination have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the precisely defined discrete-time geometric-emigration branching chain, 2/3<p<1, one-time stationary second moments; no general geometric migration processes, excursion moments, or tail equivalence. Finite code checks supplement a self-contained analytic proof.
title: Sharp stationary second-moment threshold for geometric-emigration branching
